about: Which Test Bench rows the spoken scripts cover. covers: all, or part with what stays on your list. MU, SU, WO, SE and AR are the everyday plan's ids until their rows are written.

MU2.left: "pause" with music playing. Music by voice is off in the test build, so the script's check can't fail on MusicRouter: by hand with it on

MU6.left: the whole check with Music by voice on: it is off in the test build, so the script can't fail on MusicRouter; "play a game with me" and "play my voicemail" (never said: they start with play); « mets » (the recognizer hears « mais »)

MU8.left: all of Music's answer: the test build has Music by voice off (its keys have no card), so the script only checks that the phrase goes to the model. By hand: "Robot can't see..." with no app picked, and with a music app picked

SU4.left: "set a timer for 5 minutes" is never said; Files' and Lists' replies themselves

c30-app-route.left: the tap, and the app opening

fl-french.left: the amount and file names (no demo files on the test build)

lt-french.left: French menus, the check after ticking off, « y'a-tu » and « est-tu » (the recognizer mishears them from the clip voice)

v100-anyai-apps.left: the taps, apps opening, Grok, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, the lock

v100-se-model-words.left: the Search tap, the lock, the card after a message

v11-french-times.left: the three other phrases, the time range, and the dates on the card (the runner sees the card's kind only)

v11-lock-voice.left: the lock card itself (the test build has no lock set up, so the script checks the refusal), a real lock: its cover, the lock screen, a call during it

v11-panel-split-smoke.left: all but the text card; "banana" at a card is refused by the safety rule

v11-update-from-101.left: the update, and French menus; the pause is the voice's own, not a set length

v11-voice-times.left: how times sound; the alarm's and the events' lines (an alarm is never set unattended)

v12-prompt-tools-still-work.left: the timer, the alarm and opening Clock are never said unattended; turning the GPU off

v23-say-stop.left: that she goes quiet within a second (hearing)

v23-text-ask.left: the draft opening in your messaging app

v40-free-memory.left: the app list, Usage access, the lock

v46-stop-cards.left: a yes or tap still answering the card, Claude's stream, the Tricky words test

v46-stop-long.left: the screen timeout, a tap, TalkBack, words close to stop

v70-fb-voice.left: the page Send feedback opens with Bug, the lock

v70-mem-private.left: the lock screen, Say private items aloud

v70-mem-what-saves.left: "Remember: call me Sam" (the safety rule reads "call")

v80-br-now.left: the first words within 2 s (timing the voice), calendar events (calendar never granted), the notification's buttons, the brief in French's voice, « suivant » (the recognizer hears « suivante »)

v80-br-reminders.left: the lock, the next morning's brief

v80-rt-by-voice.left: a yes, a card from the screen, the lock

hardware.why: Needs a headset, a car or another phone; clips go in after the microphone, so none of that is exercised

service.why: Needs a server, Termux, a helper's key, your own model file or an app the test build must not reach

messages.why: Needs message, contact or calendar access, which the test build is never granted

lock.why: Needs the lock screen, a restart or a real phone lock: the guard stops any input there

other-app.why: Would open, read or change another app, install something, or set a real alarm or timer

person.why: A person's speech, ears or eyes, or the room's sound (the transcript and interpreter listen to the room, not to clips)

taps.why: Depends on taps, Settings pages off the short list, a screen reader, demo files, your eyes or hours of use: a script can only speak and read

everyday.why: MU1 MU3 MU4 MU5 MU7 MU9: Media keys and play by name reach your music app, and need music playing, the lock or the car; SU6: On the lock screen, where the guard stops; WO2 WO3 WO5 WO6 WO7: Taps, Android's own count, the Network switch, a web search or Send feedback; SE1 SE2 SE3 SE4 SE5 SE6 SE7 SE8: Another app or the screen reader is the point of the test; AR1 AR2 AR3 AR4 AR5 AR6 AR7: Another app is where Ask Robot starts
